ajustes.marca_descripcion: Live tropical butterflies, sold and exported from Costa Rica with measurable social impact.
ajustes.marca_ubicacion: San Rafael de Alajuela, Costa Rica
ajustes.marca_pie: Traders and exporters of live tropical butterflies. San Rafael de Alajuela, Costa Rica.
ajustes.inicio_titular: They leave Costa Rica as pupae and emerge in your butterfly house.
ajustes.inicio_entradilla: We supply eight tropical species and export them live to butterfly houses, museums and science centers. We work with Costa Rican breeders, keep a recorded cold chain from end to end, and replace every pupa that doesn't emerge.
ajustes.ciclo_titulo: Nine days from the moment you place your order
ajustes.ciclo_texto: A pupa holds for ten to fourteen days before it emerges. Every step is timed so it arrives with room to spare, not just in time.
ajustes.ciclo_pasos:
0|Confirmation|We lock in species, quantities and flight date.
3|Collection and selection|We receive pupae from our breeders and discard any that look doubtful.
5|Cold packing|Cotton, cooling gel and a temperature logger.
9|Delivery|Customs, phytosanitary inspection and on to your butterfly house door.
ajustes.envio_condiciones:
Minimum per species|25 pupae
Transit temperature|13 °C to 16 °C
Documents included|CITES permit and phytosanitary certificate
Non-viable pupae|Replaced free of charge in your next shipment
ajustes.envio_texto: They're exported as pupae, the stage at which the insect best withstands travel. They ship in cotton-lined trays with cooling gel and a temperature logger that's read when the box is opened.
